## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, real activity data or screenshots showing your home location
- [ ] UI changes: a screenshot (crop out anything personal), and `omarchy restart shell` was run to test them
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Stays within Strava's API Agreement and brand guidelines
